- [Connect to local MCP servers](/modelcontextprotocol/docs/2026-07-28/develop/connect-local-servers): Learn how to extend Claude Desktop with local MCP servers to enable file system access and other powerful integrations
- [Connect to remote MCP Servers](/modelcontextprotocol/docs/2026-07-28/develop/connect-remote-servers): Learn how to connect Claude to remote MCP servers and extend its capabilities with internet-hosted tools and data sources
- [Build with Agent Skills](/modelcontextprotocol/docs/2026-07-28/develop/build-with-agent-skills): Use agent skills to guide AI coding assistants through MCP server design and implementation
- [Build an MCP server](/modelcontextprotocol/docs/2026-07-28/develop/build-server): Get started building your own server to use in Claude for Desktop and other clients.
- [Build an MCP client](/modelcontextprotocol/docs/2026-07-28/develop/build-client): Get started building your own client that can integrate with all MCP servers.
- [Client Best Practices](/modelcontextprotocol/docs/2026-07-28/develop/clients/client-best-practices): Patterns for scaling MCP host applications across many servers and tools.
- [SDKs](/modelcontextprotocol/docs/2026-07-28/sdk): Official SDKs for building with Model Context Protocol
- [Understanding Authorization in MCP](/modelcontextprotocol/docs/2026-07-28/tutorials/security/authorization): Learn how to implement secure authorization for MCP servers using OAuth 2.1 to protect sensitive resources and operations
- [Security Best Practices](/modelcontextprotocol/docs/2026-07-28/tutorials/security/security_best_practices): Security considerations, attack vectors, and best practices for MCP implementations
- [Local Server Security](/modelcontextprotocol/docs/2026-07-28/tutorials/security/local-server-security): Practical defaults for running MCP servers safely on your own machine.
- [MCP Inspector](/modelcontextprotocol/docs/2026-07-28/tools/inspector): Interactive developer tooling for testing and debugging MCP servers, in the browser, on the command line, and in the terminal
- [Web client](/modelcontextprotocol/docs/2026-07-28/tools/inspector/web): A tab-by-tab walkthrough of the graphical MCP Inspector
- [CLI client](/modelcontextprotocol/docs/2026-07-28/tools/inspector/cli): Scripting the MCP Inspector: methods, output formats, exit codes, and CI recipes
- [TUI client](/modelcontextprotocol/docs/2026-07-28/tools/inspector/tui): The terminal MCP Inspector: navigation, tabs, and keyboard reference
- [mcpdo connection client](/modelcontextprotocol/docs/2026-07-28/tools/inspector/mcpdo): Connect to an MCP server once, then run many commands against that named connection
- [Configuration and flags](/modelcontextprotocol/docs/2026-07-28/tools/inspector/configuration): Catalog vs. config files, which client owns which flag, and every environment variable
- [Authorization](/modelcontextprotocol/docs/2026-07-28/tools/inspector/authorization): How the MCP Inspector performs OAuth, re-authorizes mid-session, and shares tokens between its clients
- [Protocol eras](/modelcontextprotocol/docs/2026-07-28/tools/inspector/protocol-eras): How the Inspector negotiates legacy vs. modern MCP, and how every feature is handled between protocol eras
- [Recipes](/modelcontextprotocol/docs/2026-07-28/tools/inspector/recipes): Practical guides for transports, importing configs, reviewing MCP Apps, Docker, network hosting, and persistent connections with mcpdo
- [Security](/modelcontextprotocol/docs/2026-07-28/tools/inspector/security): The Inspector's threat model in one place, covering the web backend, Docker, secret storage, stdio servers, and the mcpdo daemon
- [Debugging](/modelcontextprotocol/docs/2026-07-28/tools/debugging): A comprehensive guide to debugging Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations
- [Example Servers](/modelcontextprotocol/examples): A list of example servers and implementations

- [架构](/modelcontextprotocol/zh/docs/2026-07-28/learn/architecture)
- [架构（解读）](/modelcontextprotocol/zh/docs/2026-07-28/learn/architecture-explained): 用打比方、拆解和自测的方式，把 MCP 2026-07-28 版的架构讲明白。
- [服务器](/modelcontextprotocol/zh/docs/2026-07-28/learn/server-concepts)
- [服务器（解读）](/modelcontextprotocol/zh/docs/2026-07-28/learn/server-concepts-explained): 用餐厅打比方，讲清工具、资源、提示词模板分别是什么、谁说了算，以及多个服务器怎么一起干活。
- [客户端](/modelcontextprotocol/zh/docs/2026-07-28/learn/client-concepts)
- [客户端（解读）](/modelcontextprotocol/zh/docs/2026-07-28/learn/client-concepts-explained): 讲清宿主和客户端的区别，以及征询（elicitation）如何用多轮往返在无状态下向用户要信息。
- [客户端最佳实践](/modelcontextprotocol/zh/docs/2026-07-28/develop/clients/client-best-practices): 让 MCP 宿主应用在大量服务器和工具面前依然可扩展的几种模式。
- [客户端最佳实践（解读）](/modelcontextprotocol/zh/docs/2026-07-28/develop/clients/client-best-practices-explained): 工具多到成百上千个时，宿主该怎么办：渐进式发现管“什么时候给模型看”，程序化工具调用管“怎么调用”。
